title: 1Code: the open-source GUI that makes AI coding parallel

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Stop staring at your terminal waiting for Claude to finish. Meet One Code, the open- source guey that finally makes AI coding parallel. We all know the pain. You give Claude code a task and your terminal is locked for 10 minutes. One Code fixes this by wrapping the agent in a visual dashboard that lets you run multiple tasks at once. You can have one agent fixing a bug and another writing docs simultaneously, each running in its own isolated git work
